title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 50 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 50)

content.overview: Section 50 specifies the orders from which an appeal lies in relation to a foreign award under Chapter I, principally orders refusing to refer parties to arbitration under section 45 and orders refusing enforcement under section 48. No second appeal lies except to the Supreme Court.
